sn42.7:1.1: Ekam samayam Bhagavā Nālandāyaṃ viharati Pāvārikambavane || || 2
sn42.7:1.2: Atha kho Asibandhakaputto gāmaṇi yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Asibandhakaputto gāmaṇi Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn42.7:1.5: Atha kiñcarahi bhante Bhagavā ekaccānaṃ sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ deseti || ekaccānaṃ no tathā sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ desetīti || ||
sn42.7:1.6: Tena hi gāmaṇi taṃ yevettha patipucchissāmi || yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ vyākareyyāsi || || 5
sn42.7:1.7: Taṃ kim maññasi gāmaṇi || || Idha kassakassa gahapatino tīṇi khettāni ekam khettam aggam ekaṃ khettam majjhimam ekaṃ khettaṃ hīnam jaṅgalam ūsaram pāpabhūmikaṃ ||
sn42.7:1.8: taṃ kim maññasi gāmaṇi asu kassako gahapati bījāni patiṭṭhāpetukāmo kattha pathamam patiṭṭhāpeyya || yaṃ vā aduṃ khettam aggaṃ yaṃ vā aduṃ khettaṃ majjhimaṃ yaṃ vā aduṃ khettaṃ hīnam jaṅgalam ūsaram pāpabhūminti || ||
sn42.7:1.9: Asu bhante kassako gahapati bījāni patiṭṭhāpetukāmo yam aduṃ khettam aggaṃ tattha patiṭṭhāpeyya || tattha patiṭṭhāpetvā yam aduṃ khettam majjhimam tattha patiṭṭhāpeyya || tattha patiṭṭhāpetvā yam aduṃ khettaṃ hīnam jaṅgalam ūsaram pāpabhūmi tattha patiṭṭhāpeyya pi no pi patiṭṭhāpeyya ||
sn42.7:2.1: Seyyathāpi gāmaṇi yaṃ aduṃ khettam aggam evameva mayham bhikkhu-bhikkhuniyo ||
sn42.7:2.2: tesāhaṃ dhammaṃ desemi ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇam pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇam parisuddham brahmacariyam pakāsemi || ||
sn42.7:2.4: ete hi gamaṇi maṃdīpā maṃleṇā maṃtāṇā maṃsaraṇā viharanti || || 7
sn42.7:2.5: Seyyathāpi gāmaṇi yam aduṃ khettam majjhimam evam eva mayham upāsakā upāsikāyo
sn42.7:2.6: tesam pāhaṃ dhammaṃ desemi ādikalyāṇam majjhe kalyāṇam pariyosānakalyāṇam sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇam parisuddham brahmacariyam pakāsemi || ||
sn42.7:2.8: ete hi gāmaṇi maṃdīpā maṃleṇā maṃtāṇā maṃsaraṇā viharanti || || 8
sn42.7:2.9: Seyyathāpi gāmaṇi yam aduṃ khettaṃ hīnaṃ jaṅgālam ūsaram pāpabhumi evam eva mayham aññatitthiyā samaṇabrāhmaṇaparibbājakā ||
sn42.7:2.10: tesam pāham dhammaṃ desemi ādikalyānaṃ majjhe kalyāṇam pariyosānakalyānam sāttham savyañjanam kevalaparipuṇṇam parisuddham brahmacariyam pakāsemi || ||
sn42.7:2.12: appeva nāma ekapadam pi ājāneyyuṃ taṃ nesam assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti || || 9
sn42.7:3.1: Seyyathāpi gāmaṇi purisassa tayo udakamaṇikā || eko udakamaṇiko acchiddo ahāri aparihāri || eko udakamaṇiko acchiddo hāri parihāri || eko udakamaṇiko chiddo hāri parihāri || ||
sn42.7:3.2: Taṃ kim maññasi gāmaṇi asu puriso udakaṃ nikkhipitukāmo kattha pathamam nikkhipeyya || yo vā so udakamaṇiko acchiddo ahārī aparihārī yo vā so udakamaṇiko acchiddo hāri parihārī yo vā so udakamaṇiko chiddo hārī parihārī ti || ||
sn42.7:3.3: Asu bhante puriso udakaṃ nikkhipitukāmo yo so udakamaṇiko acchiddo ahāri aparihāri tattha nikkhipeyya || tattha nikkhipetvā || yo so udakamaṇiko acchiddo hārī parihārī tattha nikkhipeyya || tattha nikkhipitvā yo so udakamaṇiko chiddo hārī parihāri tattha nikkhipeyyāpi no pi nikkhipeyya || ||
sn42.7:4.1: Seyyathāpi gāmaṇi yo so udakamaṇiko acchiddo ahārī aparihārī evam evam mayham bhikkhu-bhikkhuniyo
sn42.7:4.2: tesāhaṃ dhammaṃ desemi ādikalyāṇanam majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosāṇakalyāṇam sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇam parisuddham brahmacariyam pakāsemi || ||
sn42.7:4.4: ete hi gāmaṇi maṃdīpā maṃleṇā maṃtāṇā maṃsaraṇā viharanti || || 11
sn42.7:4.5: Seyyathāpi gāmaṇi yo so udakamaṇḍiko acchiddo hārī parihārī evam eva mayham upāsaka-upāsikāyo tesaṃ
sn42.7:4.6: pahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi ādikalyāṇam majjhe kalyāṇam pariyosanakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇam parisuddham brahmacariyam pakāsemi || ||
sn42.7:4.8: ete hi gāmaṇi maṃdīpā maṃleṇā maṃtānā maṃsaraṇā viharanti || || 12
sn42.7:4.9: Seyyathāpi gāmaṇi yo so udakamaṇiko chiddo hārī parihārī evam eva mayham aññatitthiyā samaṇabrāhmaṇā paribbājakā tesam
sn42.7:4.10: pahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇam pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sāttham savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇam parisuddham brahmacariyam pakāsemi || ||
sn42.7:4.12: appeva nāma ekapadam ājāneyyuṃ || taṃ nesam assa dīgharattam hitāya sukhāyāti || || 13
sn42.7:5.1: Evaṃ vutte Asibandhakaputto gāmaṇi Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn42.7:5.3: upāsakam maṃ Bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pānupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan
